'''Erdan''' was an [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]], chemically [[Giantism|enlarged]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], he walked with another Human at the outskirts of Mos Espa, passing by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], and the [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].

==Biography==
Erdan was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]],<ref name="CSWE" /> a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]],<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> and was [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]].<ref name="CSWE" /> He had the normalcy of a standard Human before his [[Slaver/Legends|enslaver]] chemically [[Giantism|enlarged]] him<ref name="CSWE" /> to increase his work rate,<ref name="TVD">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]'' </ref> giving him greater strength and endurance.<ref name="CSWE" /> In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}} to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> Erdan walked through the outskirts of Mos Espa with a shorter member of his [[Species/Legends|species]]. As he walked, he passed by near the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], the disguised [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], and the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. He briefly watched the group enter the city, before turning his gaze downward.<ref name="TPM" />

==Personality and traits==
The permanent heat-bonded [[Color/Legends|black]] and white patterned paint located on his face served as a symbol of ownership over him. Erdan had tanned skin, black [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and stood at a towering height.<ref name="CSWE" /> "Erdan" was a [[Gender/Legends|masculine]] first name hailing from Human culture.<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

==Skills and abilities==
After being chemically enlarged, Erdan had more strength and endurance than a normal Human.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Equipment==
While at Mos Espa, Erdan wore a light taupe [[Clothing/Legends|shirt]], a hat of the same color, greenish-brown pants, brown shoes, and a gray shawl<ref name="CSWE" /> secured to his chest with two [[Belt/Legends|belts]].<ref name="TPM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Erdan first appeared in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']],<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> released on [[May 19]], [[1999]].<ref name=Year>''[[Star Wars Year by Year: A Visual Chronicle]]''</ref> Erdan's scenes, where the character was portrayed by an uncredited extra,<ref name="TPM" /> were filmed in [[Oung Jmel|Chott el Gharsa]], [[Tunisia]], between [[July 28]] and [[July 29]], [[1997]].<ref name="Archives">''[[The Star Wars Archives: Episodes I–III, 1999–2005]]''</ref> The character was then revealed through the Episode I Preview Album made available through [[StarWars.com]] on [[October 7]], 1997.<ref name="PreviewAlbum">{{SWArchive|url=episode-i/bts/production/f19971007/index.html|text=Episode I Preview Album}}</ref> After Episode I's release,<ref name="Year" /> Erdan was first identified in the ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]'', written by [[David West Reynolds (real person)|David West Reynolds]]<ref name="TVD" /> and published on [[September 15]], 1999.<ref name="DK">{{DK|subdomain=us|url=nf/Book/BookDisplay/0,,11_0789447010,00.html|text=Star Wars Episode 1: Visual Dictionary|nolive=1}}</ref>
